present_illness.present_illness: A few days ago, the patient felt that there was a hole in the upper and lower right back teeth for several days. He denied the pain caused by hot and cold stimulation and spontaneous pain, which affected his appearance, so he came to our hospital to ask for fillings.

past_history.present_illness: A few days ago, the patient felt that there was a hole in the upper and lower right back teeth for several days. He denied the pain caused by hot and cold stimulation and spontaneous pain, which affected his appearance, so he came to our hospital to ask for fillings.

oral_examination.oral_examination: *16 Dental defects can be seen on the mesio-proximal surface, and there is soft decay inside. The probe can be inserted into it. The surface is rough and there is a slight sour feeling when probing. The teeth are slightly sensitive to cold water stimulation. The cold diagnosis is the same as the control teeth. There is no pain when percussion. There is a small amount of soft calculus on the gingival margin.

treatment_plan.notes: Avoid acidic foods within a week and avoid hot and cold stimulation. Maintain oral hygiene as directed by your doctor and rinse with mouthwash. Regular re-examination and follow-up treatment if any discomfort occurs.

source_handle: *16 After caries removal, the middle layer of dentin is reached, the cavity is trimmed, 3m of the eighth generation adhesive is applied, Songfeng F00 resin is filled, blended and polished
